newsitem.title: GERMANY: Egypt's Mubarak meets Kohl, urges EU Mideast role.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak meets Kohl, urges EU Mideast role.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak met Chancellor Helmut Kohl and other senior German politicians on Tuesday, urging the European Union to play a more pronounced political role in the Middle East peace process.

Mubarak and Kohl also discussed bilateral relations, which the Egyptian leader described as "excellent". Kohl praised Mubarak for playing an important role in attempts to bring a lasting peace to the Middle East.
"Peace is more than just the absence of war," the chancellor said in a brief statement to welcome Mubarak before the talks.
Earlier in the day, Mubarak told Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel he was concerned and increasingly disappointed by the lack of progress in the peace process, Kinkel's ministry said.
"Mubarak appealed to the European Union to take on a more pronounced political role in the peace process together with the United States," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement.
Kinkel said the EU was determined to continue its support for the peace process and its Middle East envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos was attempting to break the stagnation.
